headline: CHC @ NYM matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHC 4.12 at NYM 4.61, with a projected total of 8.73. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward NYM: CHC moved +0.01 runs while NYM moved +0.30, changing the projected margin by -0.28 runs. The projected total climbed +0.31, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -9.1%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Nolan McLean has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Pete Crow-Armstrong, Seiya Suzuki, Juan Soto, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags MJ Melendez, Brett Baty because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
